notes.title: Flight Training [Alpha Preview]
notes.content:
This is a preview of our current prologue mission in the alpha build of Remnant Protocol. We're using this mission as a benchmark for the fidelity of scripted behaviours one should expect in the final campaign.

As an alpha build, the assets, gameplay and writing are subject to change as we continuously iterate and improve the game. Especially the voice acting, which are just placeholders from us developers.

notes.title: New space game Remnant Protocol blends XCOM strategy with realistic dogfights
notes.content:
At the core of Remnant Protocol is a relentless, slow-turn tension. A first-person space dogfight shooter in the vein of TIE Fighter and Wing Commander, at the start of your missions, the gorgeous pink-and-orange galaxy feels boundless. The controls are smooth. The engine hums along. You can hold the trigger to freely turn your head in the cockpit, and admire the sights and stars around you. But then the enemy drops out of warp speed and everything becomes a desperate scramble. You've trained these pilots. You've built these ships. And now they're being soundlessly plucked out of the cosmos by missiles and laser fire. After the battle is won, the pressure stays high - blending combat with XCOM-style base and squad strategy, in Remnant Protocol, the burden of command lies heavy.

notes.title: XCOM and Tie Fighter collide in this new space sim and strategy game
notes.content:
Tie Fighter remains one of those real pinnacle moments, often talked about not only as one of the best Star Wars games but indeed one of the best PC games ever. Capturing those intense space battles and combining them with an XCOM style management layer putting you in charge of the galactic rebellion is a new space strategy game coming to Steam in 2024. At GDC, PCGamesN spoke to Scott McCallum, CEO of Progenitor Game Studios, the three-person team working on Remnant Protocol, about its new project.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: A New Hope
notes.content:
We're bursting at the seams with excitement because we can finally share our incredible news!

Due to the magnitude of the deal, as well as the company involved, unfortunately we're bound by NDAs and are unable to say exactly who just yet.  The plan from marketing is to make a large-scale announcement for maximum impact once the game is a little further along in development.

This collaboration is a significant milestone for our small studio, and we want to express our deepest gratitude to each and every one of you for being a part of this journey. Your unwavering support has been the driving force behind Remnant Protocol, and we couldn't have come this far without you.

[b]IMPACT ON PROGENITOR GAME STUDIOS[/b]

Partnering with a large publisher brings a wealth of resources to the table that allows us to focus more on perfecting the game itself, ensuring it meets not only our own high standards, but your expectations as well.  

Our humble team will be quadrupling in size, from three to twelve by the end of production, and most importantly: [b]we'll finally be able to work on Remnant Protocol full-time.[/b]

Moreover, our publisher's expertise and guidance will aid us in navigating the complex commercial landscape of game development that not only secures the future of Progenitor but also opens up opportunities for growth that we could only dream of before.

[b]IMPACT ON REMNANT PROTOCOL[/b]

The backing of our new publisher means Remnant Protocol's production values will be able to reach even greater levels. 

You can expect richer gameplay, significantly improved graphics and audio along with an enhanced, more immersive VR experience.  While the core features and scope are remaining the same -- deliberately -- every element of the game is being upgraded to give it an elevated feel.

It's important to reiterate that we're working with a publishing [b]partner[/b] that believes in the game's vision as much as we do.  As such, we've ensured that contractually we remain in complete control of the game's design and features.  We would never allow the game to be ruined by simplifying the design to appeal to the lowest common denominator or littering it with micro-transactions.

[b]IMPACT ON YOU[/b]

Unfortunately we have to push the game's release date to the 2024 holiday season at the earliest. 

We're truly sorry, but the reality is all of our limited development time over the last twelve months has been focused entirely on getting this deal off the ground.  We promise you're going to start seeing the fruits of our labour by spring.

Your support has been the backbone of Remnant Protocol and we want to assure you that our new partnership will only enhance your gaming experience.  You believed in us from the beginning, and now, together with our publisher, we're poised to deliver a game that exceeds your expectations.

Stay tuned for more updates!  If you have any questions or comments, please don't hesitate to reach out.
